programs.title: Unsellable Houses
programs.desc: While looking for an old friend, Leslie and Lyndsay meet fellow VW enthusiasts who are struggling to sell a house they built 15 years ago. The twins update the home's builder-grade materials and add darker finishes for an elegant twist.

programs.title: Beachfront Bargain Hunt: Renovation
programs.sub_title: Revamping a Home to Host Family on the Delaware Coast
programs.desc: A married couple living in Delaware have always dreamed of finding a property on the water. Now, they're searching for a home they can transform into a gathering place for their family to enjoy time together.

programs.title: The Block
programs.desc: The twins scheme up a plan to earn some cash while getting a tan. Shelley has a challenge worth $5000, that will put to test everything our blockheads have learnt about renovating and styling since walking on to The Block nine weeks ago.

programs.title: Down Home Fab
programs.desc: Chelsea and Cole take on a local real estate agent who could help make or break their design business.

programs.title: Masters Of Flip
programs.desc: Kortney and Dave flip a gutted house in a sought-after neighbourhood. Kortney tries to find balance between masculine and feminine when pink is her inspiration.

programs.title: House Hunters International
programs.sub_title: A Big Change in Chiang Mai
programs.desc: A military vet heads to Thailand, sight unseen, to help navigate life's setbacks, which includes divorce, injury and PTSD. Exhausted by Alaska's winter, he's seeking a sunny haven for himself with space for his visiting teenage daughter.

programs.title: House Hunters
programs.desc: A Seattle transplant is ready to get out of her apartment and buy a place of her own. She's hoping for something modern and spacious, but her new boyfriend is along for the ride, and he's pushing for a place with a more manageable size.

programs.title: House Hunters
programs.desc: A real estate agent couple is looking for a larger house for their growing family in Indianapolis. She's hoping for something grand with a white kitchen and a lot of space, but he's pushing for a more modest place with privacy and a finished basement.

programs.title: Chateau DIY
programs.desc: Tim and Sasha are like fish out of water as they take on a new water feature in the garden. Alison and Zion add a Moroccan twist in the bridal suite, Becky and Mark are in a tight squeeze battling to move a spiral staircase into their gite.

programs.title: Escape To The Chateau
programs.desc: The whole family help to build an open kitchen and create a pop-up restaurant in the orangery to celebrate Dick and Angel's fifth wedding anniversary. Plus: a special fairy-tale carriage delivery.

programs.title: Renovation Nation
programs.desc: In Warwickshire, Andrew and Mandy discover hidden treasures. Drew's Cornish Regency villa is almost complete. And Steve and Sally create a garden room with a view.

programs.title: Derelict Rescue
programs.desc: From crumbling railway stations to abandoned RAF bases it is time to save the UK's abandoned buildings. Enthusiastic families across the UK are turning neglected relics into a unique place to live.
